# Sof-IA

> A human-AI collaboration studio. Made with intelligence. Both kinds. Writing, music and methodology built through sustained collaboration between a person and AI models.

## Foundation

- [CogniVerse — plain text](https://sof-ia.io/cogniverse/cogniverse.txt): A statement on human-AI collaboration, written to be read by a model at the start of a conversation. Read this first.
- [CogniVerse — web page](https://sof-ia.io/cogniverse/): The same statement, designed for people.

## Work

- [The AI Bar](https://sof-ia.io/ai-bar/): A radio opera: stories by the roadside about working alongside AI.
- [Liminal](https://sof-ia.io/liminal/): A cyberpunk musical triptych, told in reverse.
- [Signal Log](https://sof-ia.io/signal-log/): A running record of real, verified things AI has done, each with its status and source. No promises.
